newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ELSEVIER HAS NO COMMENT ON BID SPECULATION.
newsitem.headline: ELSEVIER HAS NO COMMENT ON BID SPECULATION.

text.p: Elsevier NV said on Thursday it had no comment on persistent market speculation that its associate Reed International Plc might become the target of a bid from Reuters Holdings Plc .
"I have no comment," Elsevier deputy chairman Paul Vlek said in response to a query from Reuters.

Elsevier and Reed merged their operations in 1993 to form the Reed Elsevier publishing group. Vlek is also one of five members of the Reed Elsevier executive committee which has day-to-day responsibility for the Reed Elsevier businesses.

The bid rumours have contributed to a rise in Reed's shares in London. Amsterdam dealers have also cited the rumours to explain a rise in Elsevier's shares which were 0.50 guilders higher at 31.40 by 1120 GMT.
